The actual averaged Gaussian target has the product of the actual single-block mixture densities and the standard residual density, with unit total mass.  ar p_b(x_1,\ldots,x_k,z)=\prod_{j=1}^k p_b(x_j)\,\varphi_r(z),\qquad\int ar p_b=1. \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\ge4\), with inclusive endpoints; \(k=\lfloor d/nfloor\) and \(r=d-kn=d mod n\). Fix one \(b\in\{-1,+1\}\) across all independently drawn blocks. For normalized Haar probability \(\mu_n\) on the full real orthogonal group, put \(
u_b=2\mu_n|_{\{\det O=b\}}\). Set \(A_O= rac{\kappa+1}{2}I- rac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^	op)\), \(A_{ oldsymbol O}=\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r)\), and \(\mathcal D_b=( oldsymbol O\mapsto A_{ oldsymbol O})_\#
u_b^{\otimes k}\). The target is the actual Gaussian mixture \( ar\pi_b=\int\mathcal N(0,A^{-1})\,d\mathcal D_b(A)\). The single-block law is \(P_b=\int\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\,d
u_b(O)\). The shared Eq6 and density producers internally establish their probability, Gaussian-domain and measurability facts. Use the actual precision-density representative \(p_O(x)=\sqrt{\det A_O}(2\pi)^{-n/2}e^{-x^	op A_Ox/2}\) and \(p_b(x)=\int p_O(x)\,d
u_b(O)\). The existing actual-mixture-density theorem proves every-point inner integrability and the actual law equality; totalized real integration is not used as a fallback. Other source density representatives agree almost everywhere, rather than pointwise. The split uses zero-based coordinates \((x_j)_i=x_{jn+i}\) and \(z_t=x_{kn+t}\). Ambient Euclidean volume and product block/residual Lebesgue volume are the base measures. Volume preservation and bijectivity are proved; the ordinary Pi maximum norm is not declared isometric to the ambient Euclidean norm. For \(r>0\), \(\varphi_r(z)=(2\pi)^{-r/2}e^{-\lVert zVert^2/2}\) is the printed residual Gaussian density. For \(r=0\), the sole vector has unit Lebesgue mass, the Gaussian is the unit point mass and \(\varphi_0=1\); this realizes the source omitted-factor case. No positive-remainder premise is added.

    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = 1 ∨ b = -1),
    letI : MeasurableSpace (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := borel _
    let e : ((Fin n × Fin (d / n)) ⊕ Fin (d % n)) ≃ Fin d :=
      ((Equiv.sumCongr
        ((Equiv.prodComm (Fin n) (Fin (d / n))).trans finProdFinEquiv)
        (Equiv.refl (Fin (d % n)))).trans finSumFinEquiv).trans
        (finCongr (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_add_mod d n))
    let split : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →
        (Fin (d / n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) :=
      fun x => (fun j => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (e (Sum.inl (i, j)))),
        WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (e (Sum.inr i))))
    let B : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
      fun O => ((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) -
      ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) +
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)
    let ν := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • (Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))).restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = b}
    let D := (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (d / n) => ν)).map (fun Os : Fin (d / n) → Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ => Matrix.reindex e e
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun j => B (Os j))) 0 0
        (1 : Matrix (Fin (d % n)) (Fin (d % n)) ℝ)))
    let γ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :=
      fun A => multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) A⁻¹
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (B O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
        Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
          (B O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let pb : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂ν
    let φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) → ℝ :=
      fun z => (2 * Real.pi) ^ (-((d % n : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * Real.exp (-‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2)
    let q : (Fin (d / n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ×
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) → ℝ :=
      fun y => (∏ j, pb (y.1 j)) * φ y.2
    MeasurePreserving split volume volume ∧
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ q y) ∧ Measurable q ∧ Integrable q volume ∧ (∫ y, q y) = 1 ∧

decoder_context: EuclideanSpace real (Fin m) is real m-dimensional Euclidean space with its usual Borel structure; Fin m indexes coordinates from zero. WithLp.toLp 2 and WithLp.ofLp preserve the entries. Ordinary finite function spaces and products carry product Borel structures and their usual default product norms.

Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) real is the full real orthogonal matrix group, with its usual topology and Borel structure, including either determinant sign. Matrix.PosDef means a real symmetric positive-definite matrix.

Measure.haarMeasure K is the canonical Haar measure normalized on the positive compact set K. TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts top is the entire compact group, so this constructor is its normalized Haar probability. Measure.restrict restricts a measure to a set; real nonnegative-infinite scalar multiplication has its usual meaning.

Matrix.reindex e e M has entries M (e.symm i) (e.symm j). Matrix.blockDiagonal f uses pairs (local coordinate, block index) and is zero between different blocks. Matrix.fromBlocks is the displayed two-by-two block assembly. finProdFinEquiv sends (a,b) to a times the cardinality of the second factor plus b; finSumFinEquiv concatenates its summands.

multivariateGaussian mean m covariance C is the pushforward of stdGaussian by z -> m + Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt C) z. The covariance interpretation holds when C is positive semidefinite; otherwise this total constructor defaults to a point mass. Matrix inverse is totalized at singular matrices.

stdGaussian is the standard Gaussian obtained by independent scalar standard normal coordinates in an orthonormal basis. On a zero-dimensional Euclidean space it is the probability point mass at its sole vector.

Measure.map is measurable pushforward; Measure.bind integrates the displayed measure-valued family. Measure.pi and Measure.prod are actual finite independent and binary products. IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one, and the almost-everywhere quantifier is with respect to its displayed measure. Natural division and remainder and real scalar arithmetic have their ordinary Lean meanings.

volume denotes canonical Euclidean Lebesgue measure; on ordinary finite function spaces and products it is the product of the component volumes. MeasurePreserving f mu nu means f is measurable and its pushforward sends mu exactly to nu.

Real Bochner integration is totalized (zero on nonintegrable input). Integrable denotes genuine L1 with respect to the displayed measure. Measurable is Borel measurability on these carriers. volume.withDensity (ofReal q) is the nonnegative density measure. ENNReal.ofReal truncates negative real inputs to zero; pointwise q nonnegativity is separately asserted. Real square root, exponential, norm and real powers have their usual Lean meanings.

import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.AveragedBlockLaw
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.MixtureDensities
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.NormedSpace

open Matrix MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal BigOperators
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.OrthogonalHaar
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantFamily

/-!
# Actual product density of the averaged block Gaussian law

Zhou--Suzuki, arXiv:2610.20492v1, Appendix B.2.3 Ex70, from the actual
Eq6 law and actual single-block mixture density representatives. The literal
contiguous split preserves canonical Lebesgue volume; no isometry from the
ambient Euclidean norm to the ordinary Pi maximum norm is asserted.
The actual prior/Gaussian bind has the product density in both coordinate
spaces, with genuine L1 and mass one. The zero-dimensional residual has unit
density, implementing the source's omitted-factor convention.
Affinity tensorization Ex71, amplified TV Ex72 and the oracle lower bounds
remain separate mathematical obligations.
-/

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.ProductDensity
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem actual_product_density {d n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hnd : n ≤ d)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = 1 ∨ b = -1) :
    letI : MeasurableSpace (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := borel _
    let e : ((Fin n × Fin (d / n)) ⊕ Fin (d % n)) ≃ Fin d :=
      ((Equiv.sumCongr
        ((Equiv.prodComm (Fin n) (Fin (d / n))).trans finProdFinEquiv)
        (Equiv.refl (Fin (d % n)))).trans finSumFinEquiv).trans
        (finCongr (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_add_mod d n))
    let split : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →
        (Fin (d / n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) :=
      fun x => (fun j => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (e (Sum.inl (i, j)))),
        WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (e (Sum.inr i))))
    let ν := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • (orthogonalHaar n).restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = b}
    let D := (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (d / n) => ν)).map (blockPrecision κ)
    let γ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :=
      fun A => multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) A⁻¹
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
        Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
          (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let pb : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂ν
    let φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) → ℝ :=
      fun z => (2 * Real.pi) ^ (-((d % n : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * Real.exp (-‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2)
    let q : (Fin (d / n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ×
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) → ℝ :=
      fun y => (∏ j, pb (y.1 j)) * φ y.2
    MeasurePreserving split volume volume ∧
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ q y) ∧ Measurable q ∧ Integrable q volume ∧ (∫ y, q y) = 1 ∧
      (D.bind γ).map split = volume.withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (q y)) ∧
      D.bind γ = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (q (split x))) ∧
      (d % n = 0 → ∀ z, φ z = 1) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let : MeasurableSpace (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := borel _
  let e : ((Fin n × Fin (d / n)) ⊕ Fin (d % n)) ≃ Fin d :=
    ((Equiv.sumCongr
      ((Equiv.prodComm (Fin n) (Fin (d / n))).trans finProdFinEquiv)
      (Equiv.refl (Fin (d % n)))).trans finSumFinEquiv).trans
      (finCongr (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_add_mod d n))
  let split : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →
      (Fin (d / n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) :=
    fun x => (fun j => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (e (Sum.inl (i, j)))),
      WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (e (Sum.inr i))))
  let ν := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • (orthogonalHaar n).restrict
    {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = b}
  let D := (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (d / n) => ν)).map (blockPrecision κ)
  let γ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :=
    fun A => multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) A⁻¹
  let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
    fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
      (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
      Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
  let pb : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂ν
  let φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) → ℝ :=
    fun z => (2 * Real.pi) ^ (-((d % n : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * Real.exp (-‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2)
  let q : (Fin (d / n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ×
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n)) → ℝ :=
    fun y => (∏ j, pb (y.1 j)) * φ y.2
  let : BorelSpace (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := ⟨rfl⟩
  let k := d / n
  let En := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
  let Er := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d % n))
  let X := (Fin k → En) × Er
  let cur : (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ) ≃ᵐ (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ) :=
    { toEquiv :=
        { toFun := fun f j i => f (i,j)
          invFun := fun f ij => f ij.2 ij.1
          left_inv := fun _ => rfl
          right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
      measurable_toFun := by
        change Measurable (fun f : (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ) => fun j i => f (i,j))
        fun_prop
      measurable_invFun := by
        change Measurable (fun f : (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ) => fun ij : Fin n × Fin k => f ij.2 ij.1)
        fun_prop }
  have hcurv : MeasurePreserving cur volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (fun f : (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ) => fun j i => f (i,j)) volume volume
    let L : (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ) :=
      { toFun := fun f j i => f (i,j)
        invFun := fun f ij => f ij.2 ij.1
        left_inv := fun _ => rfl
        right_inv := fun _ => rfl
        map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
        map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
    have hLm : Measurable L := L.toContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous.measurable
    have : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) := inferInstance
    have : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ)) :=
      Measure.pi.isAddHaarMeasure (fun _ : Fin k => (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)))
    let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
        ((volume : Measure (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ)).map L) := inferInstance
    have hc := Measure.isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul
      ((volume : Measure (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ)).map L)
      (volume : Measure (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ))
    have hflat : (volume : Measure (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ)) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1 := by
      simp [← Set.pi_univ_Icc, volume_pi_pi]
    have hnested : (volume : Measure (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ)) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1 := by
      simp [← Set.pi_univ_Icc, volume_pi_pi]
    have hpre : L ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 1 = Set.Icc 0 1 := by
      ext f
      change ((∀ j i, 0 ≤ f (i,j)) ∧ (∀ j i, f (i,j) ≤ 1)) ↔
        ((∀ ij, 0 ≤ f ij) ∧ (∀ ij, f ij ≤ 1))
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h0,h1⟩
        exact ⟨fun ij => h0 ij.2 ij.1, fun ij => h1 ij.2 ij.1⟩
      · rintro ⟨h0,h1⟩
        exact ⟨fun j i => h0 (i,j), fun j i => h1 (i,j)⟩
    have heval := congrArg (fun M : Measure (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ) => M (Set.Icc 0 1)) hc
    rw [Measure.map_apply hLm measurableSet_Icc, hpre, hflat,
      Measure.smul_apply, hnested] at heval
    have heval' : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) =
        (((volume : Measure (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ)).map L).addHaarScalarFactor
          (volume : Measure (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ)) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      simpa only [ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using heval
    have hc1 : ((volume : Measure (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ)).map L).addHaarScalarFactor
        (volume : Measure (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ)) = 1 := ENNReal.coe_eq_one.mp heval'.symm
    have hLfun : (L : (Fin n × Fin k → ℝ) → (Fin k → Fin n → ℝ)) =
        (fun f j i => f (i,j)) := rfl
    refine ⟨hLm, ?_⟩
    rw [hc1, one_smul, hLfun] at hc
    exact hc
  let em : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) ≃ᵐ X :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin d → ℝ)).symm.trans <|
      (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ) e).symm.trans <|
      (MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi (fun _ => ℝ)).trans <|
      (cur.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (Fin (d % n) → ℝ))).trans
        ((MeasurableEquiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : Fin k =>
          MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin n → ℝ))).prodCongr
          (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin (d % n) → ℝ)))
  have hem : (em : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → X) = split := rfl
  have hvol : MeasurePreserving em volume volume := by
    exact ((volume_preserving_pi (fun _ : Fin k =>
      PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin n))).prod
      (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin (d % n)))).comp
      ((hcurv.prod (MeasurePreserving.id volume)).comp
        ((volume_measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi (fun _ => ℝ)).comp
          ((volume_measurePreserving_piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ) e).symm.comp
            (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin d)))))
  have hsplit : MeasurePreserving split volume volume := by rw [← hem]; exact hvol
  -- Actual single-block densities are supplied by the same canonical producer.
  let P := ν.bind (fun O => multivariateGaussian (0 : En) (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹)
  have hpb : (∀ x, 0 ≤ pb x) ∧ Measurable pb ∧ Integrable pb volume ∧
      (∫ x, pb x) = 1 ∧ P = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (pb x)) := by
    have hm := MixtureDensities.actual_mixture_densities hn hκ
    rcases hm with ⟨h0,hmp,hmn,hip,hin,hp1,hn1,hdp,hdn⟩
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨fun x => (h0 x).1, hmp, hip, hp1, hdp⟩
    · exact ⟨fun x => (h0 x).2, hmn, hin, hn1, hdn⟩
  have hEq6 := AveragedBlockLaw.actual_averaged_block_product hn hnd hκ hb
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure P := hEq6.2.2.1
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (D.bind γ) := hEq6.2.2.2.1
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ((volume : Measure En).withDensity
      (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (pb x))) := hpb.2.2.2.2 ▸ inferInstance
  -- The standard residual density is valid in every finite dimension.
  have hnormal : ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) ^ (d % n) =
      (2 * Real.pi) ^ (-((d % n : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) := by
    calc
      _ = 1 / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (((d % n : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) := by
        rw [inv_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
          ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi)]
        simp only [show (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((d % n : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          ((d % n : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 by ring, one_div]
      _ = _ := by rw [neg_div, Real.rpow_neg, one_div]; positivity
  have hφd : stdGaussian Er = (volume : Measure Er).withDensity
      (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (φ z)) := by
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one, one_smul, Measure.map_id', mul_one,
      finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin, hnormal, φ, Er] using
      (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.IsotropicGaussianDensity.map_sqrt_smul_stdGaussian_eq_withDensity
        (E := Er) 1 zero_lt_one)
  have hφ0 (z : Er) : 0 ≤ φ z := by dsimp [φ]; positivity
  have hφm : Measurable φ := by dsimp [φ]; fun_prop
  have hq0 (y : X) : 0 ≤ q y :=
    mul_nonneg (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => hpb.1 (y.1 j))) (hφ0 y.2)
  have hqm : Measurable q :=
    (Finset.measurable_prod _ (fun j _ =>
      hpb.2.1.comp ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_fst))).mul
      (hφm.comp measurable_snd)
  have hblocks : Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => P) =
      (volume : Measure (Fin k → En)).withDensity
        (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (∏ j, pb (y j))) := by
    rw [hpb.2.2.2.2,
      ← AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.RadonNikodym.pi_withDensity_prod
        (μ := fun _ : Fin k => (volume : Measure En))
        (f := fun _ : Fin k => fun x : En => ENNReal.ofReal (pb x))
        (fun _ : Fin k => ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hpb.2.1),
      ← volume_pi]
    congr 1
    funext y
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun j _ => hpb.1 (y j))).symm
  -- The actual Eq6 law, rather than a stipulated product law, is consumed here.
  have hdensity : (D.bind γ).map split = (volume : Measure X).withDensity
      (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (q y)) := by
    rw [hEq6.2.2.2.2, hblocks, hφd,
      prod_withDensity (f := fun y : Fin k → En => ENNReal.ofReal (∏ j, pb (y j)))
        (g := fun z : Er => ENNReal.ofReal (φ z))
        (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp
          (Finset.measurable_prod Finset.univ (fun j _ => hpb.2.1.comp (measurable_pi_apply j))))
        (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hφm)]
    apply withDensity_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y =>
      (ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => hpb.1 (y.1 j)))).symm
  have hmassNN : (∫⁻ y : X, ENNReal.ofReal (q y)) = 1 := by
    have hu := congrArg (fun M : Measure X => M Set.univ) hdensity
    simpa only [Measure.map_apply hsplit.measurable MeasurableSet.univ,
      Set.preimage_univ, measure_univ, withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,
      Measure.restrict_univ] using hu.symm
  have hqi : Integrable q volume :=
    (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable hqm.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hq0)).mp (by rw [hmassNN]; exact ENNReal.one_ne_top)
  have hmass : (∫ y, q y) = 1 := by
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hq0)
      hqm.aestronglyMeasurable, hmassNN]
    simp
  -- Volume transport gives the density on the original ambient Euclidean space.
  have hback : ((volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))).withDensity
      (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (q (em x)))).map em =
      (volume : Measure X).withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (q y)) := by
    rw [AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.RadonNikodym.measurableEquiv_map_withDensity em volume
        (f := fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => ENNReal.ofReal (q (em x)))
        (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (hqm.comp em.measurable)), hvol.map_eq]
    congr 1
    funext y
    simp only [em.apply_symm_apply]
  have hambient : D.bind γ = volume.withDensity
      (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (q (split x))) := by
    apply em.measurableEmbedding.map_injective
    rw [hem] at hback ⊢
    exact hdensity.trans hback.symm
  have hunit (hr : d % n = 0) (z : Er) : φ z = 1 := by
    let : IsEmpty (Fin (d % n)) := ⟨fun i => (Nat.not_lt_zero i.val) (hr ▸ i.isLt)⟩
    have hz : z = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [φ, hz, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      zero_pow, neg_zero, zero_div, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, hr, Nat.cast_zero,
      Real.rpow_zero]
  exact ⟨hsplit, hq0, hqm, hqi, hmass, hdensity, hambient, hunit⟩

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.ProductDensity

steps.title: Identify the actual block density
steps.text: Reuse the one actual-mixture-density node for the selected common sign. It supplies the nonnegative measurable unit-mass density of the true single-block mixture, including every-point integrability of its defining Haar average. Reuse the same actual Eq6 joint-law node and its probability conclusions.
steps.lean: hpb calls MixtureDensities.actual_mixture_densities, selecting one common sign. hEq6 calls AveragedBlockLaw.actual_averaged_block_product; the local probability instances come from that genuine producer.

steps.title: Prove that the literal coordinate split preserves volume
steps.text: Remove the Euclidean coordinate wrapper, apply the exact finite permutation, split the sum index, regroup coordinates by block, and restore each Euclidean wrapper. For the regrouping map, its linear pushforward is Haar measure. Both reference measures give the unit coordinate cube mass one, so Haar uniqueness makes the scalar factor exactly one. The inverse coordinate map is measurable as well.
steps.lean: cur/hcurv construct and normalize the actual linear regrouping; hflat, hnested and hpre identify its unit cube. em composes canonical measurable equivalences, hem proves it is exactly split, and hvol/hsplit compose their real volume-preserving certificates. This proves no claim about the ordinary product maximum norm being Euclidean.

steps.title: Keep the actual residual Gaussian, including dimension zero
steps.text: Apply the canonical isotropic Gaussian density theorem at variance one, and rewrite its normalizer into the real-power convention of the source. This theorem includes zero dimension. If the remainder is zero, the vector space has one vector and the displayed residual density is one; the source factor is therefore omitted.
steps.lean: hnormal rewrites the square-root normalizer, hφd reuses map_sqrt_smul_stdGaussian_eq_withDensity, and hφ0/hφm give positivity/measurability. hunit checks the zero-dimensional formula directly using its unique vector.

steps.title: Multiply the true density measures
steps.text: The canonical finite-product density theorem identifies the product of the actual block laws with the product of their densities. The binary product density rule appends the common standard residual Gaussian. Applying the actual Eq6 equality now identifies this density with the coordinate pushforward of the actual full Gaussian mixture.
steps.lean: hblocks calls the same RadonNikodym.pi_withDensity_prod node. hdensity combines hEq6, hblocks, hφd and prod_withDensity; hq0/hqm and ofReal multiplication are discharged internally. The desired product law or density is never a caller premise or a replacement target definition.

steps.title: Return to the ambient density and prove normalization
steps.text: Transport the density back through the measurable volume-preserving bijection. Its pushforward determines the original measure, giving the ambient density. The actual target has mass one, so its coordinate density has lintegral one; nonnegativity and measurability then yield genuine real L1 and real integral one. The focused consumers evaluate arbitrary measurable sets under these same actual laws by the resulting density integrals.

对每一对自然数 d、n，只要 3 ≤ n ≤ d；对每一实数 κ，只要 κ ≥ 4；以及对每一实数 b，只要 b = 1 或 b = −1，作如下定义。实 d×d 矩阵空间采用其 Borel 可测结构。记 m = d / n、r = d % n，其中除法与余数均为自然数运算，故 d = mn + r、m ≥ 1、0 ≤ r < n。记 E_k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)，即坐标以 0,…,k−1 标记的实 k 维欧氏空间；记 Y = (Fin m → E_n) × E_r，其可测结构和体积测度是对应有限乘积的 Borel 结构与分量 Lebesgue 测度的乘积。以下 λ_d、λ_Y 分别表示 E_d、Y 上的这些 volume 测度。

定义坐标双射 e : ((Fin n × Fin m) ⊕ Fin r) ≃ Fin d：e(inl(i,j)) = jn + i，e(inr(t)) = mn + t。定义 split : E_d → Y，把 x 的坐标分成 m 个按原次序排列的连续 n 维块及最后的 r 维块，即 split(x) = ((x_j)_{j∈Fin m},z)，其中 (x_j)_i = x_{jn+i}、z_t = x_{mn+t}。这里 WithLp 的转换只改变包装，不改变坐标数值。

在实正交群 O(n) 上，对 O 定义实 n×n 矩阵 B(O) = ((κ+1)/2) I_n − ((κ−1)/4)(O+Oᵀ)。令 H 为构造 Measure.haarMeasure(⊤) 在整个紧正交群上归一化得到的 Haar 概率测度，并严格定义 ν = 2 · (H 限制于 {O∈O(n) : det O = b})；这使用全正交群上的 Haar 测度以及对指定行列式符号集合的限制和倍乘。

在 Fin m → O(n) 上取实际的有限乘积测度 ∏_{j∈Fin m} ν。对组 O⃗=(O_j)，先在 ((Fin n × Fin m) ⊕ Fin r) 的坐标中组成矩阵 diag(blockDiagonal(B(O_j)),I_r)，其中不同 n 维块之间、n 维块与余块之间的矩阵项为零，blockDiagonal 的坐标对为 (块内坐标,块编号)；再以 Matrix.reindex e e 重标记行列，即重标记后 (u,v) 项等于原矩阵 (e⁻¹(u),e⁻¹(v)) 项。令 T(O⃗) 为所得 d×d 矩阵，令 D = T_* (∏_j ν) 为这一乘积测度的实际推前测度。

对每个实 d×d 矩阵 A，定义 γ(A) = multivariateGaussian(0,A⁻¹)，这里 A⁻¹ 是 Lean 中在奇异矩阵处也有值的总化矩阵逆。multivariateGaussian 是把 d 维标准 Gaussian 测度经 z ↦ Matrix.toEuclideanCLM(CFC.sqrt(A⁻¹)) z 推前的总构造；仅当 A⁻¹ 为正半定矩阵时才有通常的协方差解释，其余情形按给定定义上下文退化为点质量。该定义没有对任意 A 另加正定或可逆假设。令 μ = D.bind γ，即按矩阵测度 D 积分这一测度值族得到的混合测度。

对 O∈O(n)、x∈E_n，定义实函数
p(O,x) = sqrt(det B(O)) / (2π)^(n/2) · exp(−xᵀB(O)x/2)，
其中 n/2 在幂中是实数除法，二次型使用 x 的实际坐标。定义 p_b(x) = ∫_{O(n)} p(O,x) dν(O)，该积分是 Lean 的实 Bochner 积分。对 z∈E_r，定义 φ(z) = (2π)^(−r/2) exp(−‖z‖²/2)，这里范数是 E_r 的欧氏范数。最后对 y=((y_j)_{j∈Fin m},z)∈Y 定义 q(y) = (∏_{j∈Fin m} p_b(y_j)) φ(z)。

则以下结论同时成立：
(1) split 对 λ_d 和 λ_Y 保测，即 split 可测且 split_*λ_d = λ_Y。
(2) 对每个 y∈Y 都有 q(y) ≥ 0；q 是 Borel 可测函数，在 λ_Y 下真正 L¹ 可积，且 ∫_Y q(y) dλ_Y(y) = 1。
(3) 混合测度在 split 下的实际推前满足 split_*μ = λ_Y.withDensity(y ↦ ENNReal.ofReal(q(y)))。也就是说，q 是这一推前测度相对于上述乘积 Lebesgue 测度 λ_Y 的密度。
(4) 原空间上的测度满足 μ = λ_d.withDensity(x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal(q(split(x))))。也就是说，x ↦ q(split(x)) 是 μ 相对于 E_d 上标准 Lebesgue 测度的密度。
(5) 若 r = d % n = 0，则对 E_0 中每个 z 都有 φ(z) = 1。此时 E_0 仅有一个向量，I_0 是空矩阵，余块体积测度和零维标准 Gaussian 都是在该唯一向量上的概率点质量，因而余块因子正是 1。

两条测度等式是 Borel 测度的精确相等，不是只在某个未指定零测集外的函数等式；q 的非负性和零余维结论中的 φ = 1 均为逐点断言。ENNReal.ofReal 在一般输入上会截去负数，但这里 q 的逐点非负性是单独给出的结论。定义 p_b 时的 Bochner 积分按给定定义在不可积输入上总化为 0；本命题另行断言的是 q 的真正可积性，并未把 p 或 p_b 的独立可积性、正定性或谱界列为额外结论。参数端点 n=3、d=n、κ=4 及 b 的两个符号都包括在量词内；d 或 n 为 0 不满足假设，m=0 也不可能，r=0 则明确包括在内。命题没有未展示的存在常数、渐近条件、概率误差界或对 κ 的上界。
